operatorChecklist: 1. Set SUPABASE_URL to the deployed Supabase project URL
2. Set SUPABASE_ANON_KEY to the project anon/publishable key
3. Set CREDENTIAL_VAULT_WORKER_TOKEN as a Supabase project secret AND in the worker runtime env
4. Set PROOF_OPERATOR_JWT to a short-lived OPERATOR or ADMIN JWT (generate via Supabase auth)
5. Set CREDENTIAL_BOUNDARY_CANARY to a disposable password in process env only (never commit)
6. Set MOBILE_MCP_BRIDGE_URL to the bridge URL with a connected Android device
7. Set WORKER_BASE_URL to the execution worker URL
8. Connect an Android device via ADB and verify it appears as ONLINE
9. Deploy the credential-vault Edge Function with verify_jwt=false and required secrets
10. Start the Mobile MCP bridge and execution worker (or set CREDENTIAL_BOUNDARY_EXISTING_*_LOG_DIR if already running)
13. Run: npm.cmd run proof:credential-boundary to verify readiness (should report ready=true)
14. When ready, execute: CREDENTIAL_BOUNDARY_ALLOW_REAL_PROOF=true npm.cmd run proof:credential-boundary -- --run-real-proof
15. Verify the result: full_verified requires all auth, login, persistence, log, and cleanup gates to pass
16. If the proof fails, follow the incident handling section in docs/runbooks/credential-boundary-real-proof.md
